description: This file defines an Android Activity 'RequestDuringLayout' demonstrating the effects of calling requestLayout() during a layout pass, including a custom LinearLayout subclass 'MyLayout' that adds/removes views during onLayout.

classes.name: RequestDuringLayout
classes.description: Main activity demonstrating requestLayout calls during a layout pass with buttons to trigger layout requests and a custom layout class.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the content view, and configures button click listeners to trigger layout requests.

classes.name: MyLayout
classes.description: Custom LinearLayout that adds/removes buttons during onLayout, illustrating problems caused by modifying layout during a layout pass.

methods.name: onLayout
methods.description: Overrides the default to add/remove buttons during layout, which can cause unstable layout behavior.

methods.name: removeButton
methods.description: Removes a button from the layout if more than one child exists.

methods.name: addButton
methods.description: Dynamically creates and adds a new button to the layout.

search-terms: add or remove views in onLayout
